title: VIP Fuzzy Lynx Twin
author: MathGuy_12
rules:
This was set for Scojo's Setting Saturday prompts. The prompt for this week was to create a puzzle using Ciphers and Clones.

Thanks to PrissyP for testing!

SudokuPad Link

Rules:

• Latin Square:

• Place the digits 0-9 once each in every row and column

• Renban:

• Magenta renbans connect consecutive digits

• Pentominoes:

• Tile the grid with pentominoes such that two pentominoes of the same shape are not orthogonally adjacent (including rotation and reflection)
• Digits in a pentomino do not repeat
• A letter clue has been given in the leftmost cell of the uppermost row of some pentominoes. This letter is the shape of the pentomino shifted down the English alphabet by the sum of the pentomino, wrapping back around to A after Z (a T pentomino with a sum of 7 would appear as A)
• Two pentominoes of the same shape must contain the same digits in the same positions (allowing for rotations and reflections)
• Pentomino shape names are F, I, L, N, P, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z

Pentomino Shapes:
solutionCode: The digits in the pentomino containing r1c6 in English reading order (5 digits)
